人教版 必修第二册 第六章 实验活动7「化学反应速率的影响因素」 + 选择性必修: PEP Required Vol. 2, Ch. 6, Lab Activity 7 "Factors affecting reaction rate" + Elective 1, Ch. 2, Sec. 1 "Rate of chemical reactions"
v = Δc/Δt · 浓度↑ / 温度↑ / 加催化剂 → 速率↑（时间↓）: v = Δc/Δt · concentration↑ / temperature↑ / add catalyst → rate↑ (time↓)
同样两个反应，为什么有的几秒就完、有的等半天？快慢到底由什么决定？: Two reactions: why is one over in seconds while the other takes ages? What decides how fast?
一次只改一个条件，其余相同: Change one condition at a time, keep the rest the same
浑浊出现时间、收集 10 mL H₂ 的时间: Time for cloudiness to appear, time to collect 10 mL H₂
单位时间有效碰撞次数↑: More effective collisions per unit time↑
四个实验站 + 一个放大模型: Four lab stations + one magnified model
整体 · 一张实验台上四组对比，旁边放大到分子: Overview · four comparisons on one bench, magnified to molecules beside it
改一个条件，看浑浊时间、气泡和曲线一起动: Change one condition and watch the cloudiness time, bubbles and curve move together
全对！变量控制、三个因素和速率换算你都理顺了。: All correct! You have variable control, the three factors and rate conversion straight.
建议回看主线：先看变量控制怎么控制，再看浓度、温度、催化剂各自作用在哪一处。: We suggest reviewing the main storyline: first how variables are controlled, then where concentration, temperature and catalyst each act.
总体积必须 4 mL = 2 mL 酸 + V + 补水: Total volume must be 4 mL = 2 mL acid + V + added water
水浴温度：冷水 15 ℃ 对照 / 可调水浴: Water bath temperature: cold water 15 ℃ control / adjustable bath
注射器量气：收集 10 mL H₂: Measure gas with a syringe: collect 10 mL H₂
示意放大 · 正在看：温度站 热水管: Magnified for clarity · now viewing: temperature station, hot tube
示意放大 · 正在看：温度站 室温管: Magnified for clarity · now viewing: temperature station, room-temperature tube
两支试管：左边原管 2 mL 当对照，右边稀释管 1 mL 加 1 mL 蒸馏水: Two tubes: on the left the original 2 mL as control, on the right the diluted tube with 1 mL plus 1 mL distilled water; add 2 mL 0.1 mol/L H₂SO₄ to each and compare how fast they cloud
两支管各 2 mL Na₂S₂O₃：一支在冷水 15 ℃ 杯里当对照，一支在可调: Two tubes of 2 mL Na₂S₂O₃ each: one in a 15 ℃ cold-water beaker as control, one in the adjustable bath; add 2 mL H₂SO₄ to each
三支管各 2 mL 10% H₂O₂：空白对照 / 2 滴 FeCl₃ / 少量: Three tubes of 2 mL 10% H₂O₂ each: blank control / 2 drops FeCl₃ / a little MnO₂; compare how fast they bubble
教材图 2-1：锥形瓶 2 g 锌粒 + 分液漏斗加 40 mL 硫酸，用注射器: Textbook Fig. 2-1: 2 g zinc granules in a conical flask + 40 mL sulfuric acid from a dropping funnel; a syringe measures the time to collect 10 mL H₂ (back row)
分子乱撞，亮色是活化分子；温度越高亮色越多（示意放大，悬在台面上方后侧）: Molecules collide at random; bright ones are activated; the higher the temperature, the more bright ones (magnified, floating above the back of the bench)
教材只给了用品和一张空表，这张表要怎么填？: The textbook only gives the materials and an empty table. How do you fill it in?
拖动视角，绕这张台面看一圈（滚轮拉近拉远）: Drag the view to orbit the bench (scroll to zoom)
四站都在：浑浊对比的两支管、冷水与可调水浴、三支 H₂O₂ 试管、后排一套测气体: All four stations are here: the two cloudiness tubes, the cold water and adjustable bath, the three H₂O₂ tubes, and a gas-volume setup in the back row; above the bench is the magnified collision model. The main reading of 40.0 s is running
0.1 mol/L 各 2 mL，总体积 4 mL（教材浓度组）: 0.1 mol/L, 2 mL each, total volume 4 mL (textbook concentration set)
四站对应教材实验活动7 的三组对比，加一组教材图 2-1 的定量测定。: The four stations match the three comparisons of textbook Lab Activity 7, plus the quantitative measurement of textbook Fig. 2-1.
并排的两支管里总有一支是对照：只改一个条件的那支叫实验管。: Of each pair of tubes, one is always the control; the one with a single condition changed is the experimental tube.
读数栏把「看得见的现象」换成秒数，才比得出快几倍。: The reading bar turns "what you see" into seconds, so you can say how many times faster.
去掉变量控制：两管同时改了两个条件，比出来的差别说不清是谁造成的。: Without variable control: both tubes change two conditions at once, and you can't tell which caused the difference.
常考「影响速率的因素有哪些」——浓度、温度、压强、催化剂，还有固体表面积。: Common question "what factors affect rate": concentration, temperature, pressure, catalyst, and surface area of solids.
教材的做法是变量控制：一次只改一个条件、其余全相同，再用「出现浑浊的时间」或「收: The textbook's method is variable control: change one condition at a time and keep everything else the same, then use "time for cloudiness" or "time to collect 10 mL H₂" to turn speed into a comparable number.
加了同样多的酸，为什么稀的那一支浑浊得更慢？: With the same amount of acid, why does the dilute tube cloud more slowly?
把稀释管的 Na₂S₂O₃ 从 2 mL 拖到 1 mL（另补 1 mL 蒸馏水: Drag the diluted tube's Na₂S₂O₃ from 2 mL to 1 mL (topped up with 1 mL distilled water) and watch the cloudiness of both tubes and the main reading
实验管浑浊时间由 20.0 s 变成 40.0 s（c 由 0.050 变成 0: The experimental tube's cloudiness time goes from 20.0 s to 40.0 s (c from 0.050 to 0.025 mol/L); the control tube on the left stays at 20.0 s; on the same clock the milkiness of the two tubes separates fast from slow
0.1 mol/L 各 2 mL · 25 ℃ · 总体积 4 mL: 0.1 mol/L, 2 mL each · 25 ℃ · total volume 4 mL
浓度减半 · 时间加倍: Half the concentration · double the time
稀释那支另加 1 mL 蒸馏水，两管总体积都是 4 mL，只有浓度不同。: The diluted tube gets 1 mL extra distilled water, so both tubes have 4 mL in total and only the concentration differs.
浓度按 0.1 mol/L × V / 4 mL 算出来，不是「看着稀一点」。: The concentration is calculated as 0.1 mol/L × V / 4 mL, not "looks a bit weaker".
浑浊计时取「刚出现乳白」，两管用同一个标准才好比。: Cloudiness is timed at "milkiness just appears"; both tubes must use the same criterion to compare.
去掉这一步的补水：体积不同、浓度算错，时间比变成 1.5 : 1，结论就说不圆了: Leave out the water top-up in this step: the volumes differ, the concentration is miscalculated, the time ratio becomes 1.5 : 1, and the conclusion no longer holds.
变量控制的写法是常考点：比较浓度必须控制温度、总体积、酸量，稀释管要补溶剂。: How to write up variable control is a common exam point: to compare concentration, control temperature, total volume and amount of acid, and top up the diluted tube with solvent.
其他条件相同时，减小反应物浓度，速率减小、时间变长：浓度减半，时间加倍（本课按一: With other conditions the same, lower reactant concentration means a slower rate and longer time: half the concentration, double the time (this lesson assumes a first-order relation, consistent with the textbook's qualitative conclusion).
A3.1、A4.4、A7.3、B2.1 算子 1/3 + D1: A3.1, A4.4, A7.3, B2.1 operators 1/3 + D1
同一支管放进热水，为什么几乎立刻浑了？: Put the same tube in hot water: why does it cloud almost at once?
把水浴从 25 ℃ 拖到 45 ℃（热水档，最高可到 65 ℃），看浑浊时间怎么: Drag the bath from 25 ℃ to 45 ℃ (hot setting, up to 65 ℃) and watch the cloudiness time fall; then try dragging it back to 15 ℃ cold water
水浴 25 → 45 ℃，浑浊时间由 20.0 s 掉到 2.4 s；冷水 15: Bath 25 → 45 ℃, cloudiness time falls from 20.0 s to 2.4 s; in 15 ℃ cold water it takes 64.7 s. Each 10 ℃ rise multiplies the rate by 2–4
升高温度 → 活化分子百分数增大 → 速率增大: Raise the temperature → larger percentage of activated molecules → faster rate
冷水约 15 ℃ · 室温 25 ℃ · 热水约 55 ℃（温度计读水温）: Cold water about 15 ℃ · room temperature 25 ℃ · hot water about 55 ℃ (thermometer reads the water)
两支管浓度相同（都是 2 mL 原管），唯一变量是水浴温度。: Both tubes have the same concentration (both 2 mL original); the only variable is the bath temperature.
教材给「每升高 10 ℃ 速率增大为原来的 2~4 倍」；本课的温度因子每 10: The textbook says "each 10 ℃ rise multiplies the rate by 2–4"; this lesson's temperature factor is about 3 per 10 ℃, within that range.
温度改的是「够能量的分子占多大比例」，不是把浓度改大。: Temperature changes "what fraction of molecules have enough energy", not the concentration.
去掉这一步：只比浓度，学生会以为「越稀越慢」是唯一规律，遇到热水里几乎瞬间浑浊就: Without this step: comparing only concentration, students think "more dilute, slower" is the only rule, and can't explain the near-instant cloudiness in hot water.
温度的影响非常显著（2~4 倍 / 10 ℃），常与浓度并列考，也常考「为什么低: The effect of temperature is very marked (2–4 times per 10 ℃); it is often tested alongside concentration, and so is "why reactions almost stop at low temperature".
其他条件相同时，升高温度速率增大、降低温度速率减小；本课温度因子下每 10 ℃: With other conditions the same, raising the temperature speeds up the rate and lowering it slows it down; with this lesson's factor of about 3 per 10 ℃ (textbook 2–4), the cloudiness time at 45 ℃ is only about one eighth of that at 25 ℃.
A3.1（温度组）、A3.3、A4.4、B2.1 算子 2/3 + D2: A3.1 (temperature set), A3.3, A4.4, B2.1 operators 2/3 + D2
只加一小撮黑色粉末，气泡为什么一下子密了？: Why do the bubbles suddenly thicken after adding just a pinch of black powder?
把「MnO₂ 粉末」拨到已加入，看那一管的气泡变成加催化剂时的样子；再拨回来对照: Set "MnO₂ powder" to added and watch that tube's bubbles change to the catalyzed rate; then set it back to compare
关着时那管与空白管一样慢（1×）；加入后气泡速率升到 8×。加 FeCl₃ 的那: While off, that tube is as slow as the blank (1×); once added the bubbling rises to 8×. The FeCl₃ tube stays at 8× throughout, and the blank tube bubbles slowly all along (the factors are illustrative; the textbook only says both are faster than the blank)
10% H₂O₂ 各 2 mL · 少量 MnO₂ · 2 滴 1 mol/L: 10% H₂O₂, 2 mL each · a little MnO₂ · 2 drops 1 mol/L FeCl₃
三支管只有加入物不同，H₂O₂ 的体积与浓度都一样（各 2 mL 10%）。: The three tubes differ only in what is added; the volume and concentration of H₂O₂ are the same (2 mL of 10% each).
空白管必须留着，否则「催化」这两个字就没了参照。: The blank tube must stay, or "catalysis" has nothing to compare with.
教材只说两种催化剂都比空白快、没比谁更快，所以本课给同一倍率，不排名次。: The textbook only says both catalysts are faster than the blank, not which is faster, so this lesson gives them the same factor and does not rank them.
去掉空白对照：没法判断气泡是不是本来就该这么快。: Without the blank control: you can't tell whether the bubbles would have been this fast anyway.
催化剂改变速率、改变反应历程，不改变反应热、不改变平衡转化率——这一句几乎是必考: A catalyst changes the rate and the reaction pathway but not the heat of reaction or the equilibrium conversion; this sentence is almost always tested.
催化剂改变反应历程、降低活化能，使活化分子数目增大、单位时间有效碰撞次数增加，速: A catalyst changes the reaction pathway and lowers the activation energy, increasing the number of activated molecules and effective collisions per unit time, so the rate increases; it changes neither the heat of reaction nor the equilibrium.
A3.1（催化剂组）、A5.6、A7.7、B2.4 + D3: A3.1 (catalyst set), A5.6, A7.7, B2.4 + D3
「快慢」能不能变成一个数？: Can "fast or slow" become a number?
把硫酸从 1 mol/L 拖到 4 mol/L，看收集 10 mL H₂ 要多久: Drag the sulfuric acid from 1 mol/L to 4 mol/L and see how long it takes to collect 10 mL H₂ and how the curve's slope changes
收集 10 mL H₂ 的时间由 64.0 s 变成 16.0 s，平均速率由: The time to collect 10 mL H₂ goes from 64.0 s to 16.0 s, and the average rate from 1.60×10⁻⁴ to 6.39×10⁻⁴ mol/(L·s); the curve's slope becomes 4 times as steep
2 g 锌粒 + 40 mL 硫酸 · 注射器量 10 mL H₂: g zinc granules + 40 mL sulfuric acid · syringe measures 10 mL H₂
10 mL H₂ 在 25 ℃、101.325 kPa 下是 4.0876×10: mL of H₂ at 25 ℃ and 101.325 kPa is 4.0876×10⁻⁴ mol; divided by 40 mL of solution, Δc = 1.02×10⁻² mol/L.
速率用 H₂SO₄ 的浓度变化除以时间，单位 mol/(L·s)。: The rate is the change in H₂SO₄ concentration divided by time, in mol/(L·s).
只收集 10 mL（反应刚开始的一小段），得到的是这一段的平均速率。: Only 10 mL is collected (a short stretch at the start), so this gives the average rate over that stretch.
去掉定量这一步：只知道「哪支快」，说不出快几倍，也没法选条件。: Without the quantitative step: you only know "which is faster", can't say how many times, and can't choose conditions.
速率计算要写清「用哪种物质、哪一段时间内的平均速率」，这也是教材练习里反复出现的: A rate calculation must state "which substance, and the average rate over which time"; this format recurs in the textbook exercises.
v = Δc/Δt：测出时间就能把快慢算成数；其他条件相同时，增大硫酸浓度速率增: v = Δc/Δt: measuring the time turns speed into a number; with other conditions the same, a higher acid concentration gives a faster rate (1 → 4 mol/L, time cut from 64.0 s to 16.0 s).
温度升高以后，瓶子里到底多了什么？: After heating, what is there more of in the flask?
点一下台面上方那个放大箱，看里面的分子怎么撞: Click the magnified box above the bench and watch how the molecules inside collide
亮色（活化）分子明显变多：25 ℃ 约 4 %，45 ℃ 约 34 %，到 55: Bright (activated) molecules clearly increase: about 4 % at 25 ℃, about 34 % at 45 ℃, and close to a full box at 55 ℃; the percentage of activated molecules rises from 1.00× to 22.1× relative to 25 ℃ (magnified for clarity)
示意放大 · 60 个分子 · 亮色比例随温度变化: Magnified for clarity · 60 molecules · bright fraction changes with temperature
分子撞在一起不等于反应：只有能量够、取向对的碰撞才有效。: Molecules colliding is not the same as reacting: only collisions with enough energy and the right orientation are effective.
温度升高不增加分子总数，增加的是「够能量的那部分」的比例。: Raising the temperature does not add molecules; it raises the fraction "with enough energy".
催化剂不改分子能量，改的是门槛——活化能降下来，够能量的分子就多了。: A catalyst doesn't change molecular energy, it changes the threshold: with a lower activation energy, more molecules have enough energy.
去掉这一步：三个因素只能靠背，学生说不出为什么温度的影响比浓度更显著。: Without this step: the three factors can only be memorized, and students can't say why temperature has a bigger effect than concentration.
用碰撞理论解释浓度、温度、催化剂三条常一起考；要能分清「单位体积活化分子数」与「: Explaining concentration, temperature and catalyst with collision theory is often tested together; tell apart "activated molecules per unit volume" and "percentage of activated molecules".
浓度增大 → 单位体积内活化分子数增多；温度升高 → 活化分子百分数增大；催化剂: Higher concentration → more activated molecules per unit volume; higher temperature → larger percentage of activated molecules; a catalyst lowers the activation energy → more molecules become activated. All three increase the effective collisions per unit time and speed up the rate.
两支管里的 Na₂S₂O₃ 不一样多、体积也不一样，这样比还公平吗？: The two tubes hold different amounts of Na₂S₂O₃ and different volumes. Is that a fair comparison?
把「补加蒸馏水」关掉（错误操作），看稀释管的浓度和时间怎么变；看完记得打开: Turn off "top up with distilled water" (a wrong procedure) and see how the diluted tube's concentration and time change; remember to turn it back on afterwards
关掉补水：稀释管浓度由 0.025 变成 0.0333 mol/L，浑浊时间由: Without the top-up: the diluted tube's concentration goes from 0.025 to 0.0333 mol/L and the cloudiness time from 40.0 s to 30.0 s (10.0 s short); the ratio to the 20.0 s control changes from 2 : 1 to 1.5 : 1
同一组对照 · 只改一个条件: Same pair of controls · only one condition changed
总体积必须 4 mL = 2 mL 酸 + V(Na₂S₂O₃) + 补水: Total volume must be 4 mL = 2 mL acid + V(Na₂S₂O₃) + added water
错误操作 → 总体积只有 3 mL → c 由 0.025 变 0.0333 →: Wrong procedure → total volume only 3 mL → c from 0.025 to 0.0333 → cloudiness time from 40.0 s to 30.0 s (too short) → the conclusion is weakened.
计时标准要一致：看「刚出现浑浊」还是「完全浑浊」，时间能差一半。: The timing criterion must be consistent: "cloudiness just appears" versus "fully cloudy" can differ by half.
温度没回到室温就换管比较，也属于没控制变量。: Swapping tubes before the temperature is back to room temperature also fails to control variables.
去掉这一步：学生会在实验报告里写出「浓度减半、时间不变」这样的错结论。: Without this step: students write wrong conclusions like "half the concentration, same time" in their lab reports.
误差分析常问「哪一步没有控制变量、结果偏大还是偏小」，答的时候要把链条写全。: Error analysis often asks "which step did not control variables, and is the result too high or too low"; write out the whole chain in your answer.
变量控制要求只改浓度、其余相同：稀释管必须补 1 mL 蒸馏水保持总体积 4 m: Variable control requires changing only the concentration and keeping the rest the same: the diluted tube must be topped up with 1 mL distilled water to keep 4 mL in total, or the concentration is miscalculated, the time is too short, and the measured difference is squeezed.
A7.3、A4.6、A3.1 注文、B1 越界表 + D5: A7.3, A4.6, A3.1 note, B1 out-of-range table + D5
考核：把教材的浓度对照实验完整复现一遍: Assessment: reproduce the textbook's concentration control experiment in full
实验管取 1 mL Na₂S₂O₃ 并补 1 mL 蒸馏水、水浴 25 ℃，让浑: Take 1 mL Na₂S₂O₃ in the experimental tube, top up with 1 mL distilled water, bath at 25 ℃, so the cloudiness time is 40.0 s ± 1.0 s, and hold for 15 seconds; partway through the bath will be raised
达标横幅「浓度对照复现成功」；水浴被抬到 45 ℃ 时浑浊时间掉到 2.4 s，: Success banner "concentration control reproduced"; when the bath is raised to 45 ℃ the cloudiness time drops to 2.4 s, and you must drag it back to 25 ℃
1 mL + 1 mL 水 · 2 mL 酸 · 25 ℃ · 总体积 4 mL: mL + 1 mL water · 2 mL acid · 25 ℃ · total volume 4 mL
不补水时间会偏到 30.0 s，差 10.0 s 就出界。: Without the top-up the time drifts to 30.0 s, 10.0 s off and out of range.

研究浓度对速率的影响时，下列做法正确的是: To study the effect of concentration on rate, the correct procedure is
两支管加不同浓度、不同温度的酸: add acid of different concentrations and temperatures to the two tubes
稀释那支补加蒸馏水，使两支管总体积相同: top up the diluted tube with distilled water so both tubes have the same total volume
用不同体积的酸，其他都不管: use different volumes of acid and ignore everything else
一支用水浴加热，另一支不放水浴: heat one tube in a water bath and leave the other out of the bath
变量控制要求只改一个条件：比较浓度时温度、总体积、酸量都要相同，所以稀释管必须补: Variable control means changing only one condition: when comparing concentration, temperature, total volume and amount of acid must all be the same, so the diluted tube must be topped up with solvent to the same volume.
关于温度对化学反应速率的影响，正确的是: About the effect of temperature on reaction rate, which is correct?
温度每升高 10 ℃，速率增大为原来的 2~4 倍: Each 10 ℃ rise multiplies the rate by 2–4
温度升高只影响平衡，不影响速率: Raising the temperature only affects equilibrium, not rate
温度升高使分子总数变多: Raising the temperature increases the total number of molecules
教材的口径是「温度每升高 10 ℃，化学反应速率通常增大为原来的 2~4 倍」；: The textbook says "each 10 ℃ rise usually multiplies the reaction rate by 2–4"; raising the temperature does not add molecules, it increases the percentage of activated molecules.
加入 MnO₂ 使 H₂O₂ 分解变快，下列判断正确的是: Adding MnO₂ speeds up the decomposition of H₂O₂. Which is correct?
MnO₂ 改变了反应的活化能，不改变反应热: MnO₂ changes the activation energy of the reaction, not the heat of reaction
MnO₂ 提高了 H₂O₂ 的浓度: MnO₂ raises the concentration of H₂O₂
MnO₂ 使平衡向生成 O₂ 的方向移动: MnO₂ shifts the equilibrium toward O₂
MnO₂ 参与了反应并使反应放热更多: MnO₂ takes part in the reaction and makes it release more heat
催化剂改变反应历程、降低活化能，使活化分子数目增大；它不改变反应热，也不改变平衡: A catalyst changes the reaction pathway and lowers the activation energy, increasing the number of activated molecules; it changes neither the heat of reaction nor the equilibrium conversion.

This lesson assumes a first-order relation: 4 times the concentration gives 4 times the rate and a quarter of the time, i.e. 16.0 s (the textbook only asks you to measure and compare; the seconds are a lesson setting).
用碰撞理论解释「升温使速率增大」，最恰当的是: The best collision-theory explanation of "heating speeds up the rate" is
活化分子百分数增大，单位时间有效碰撞次数增多: a larger percentage of activated molecules, so more effective collisions per unit time
每次碰撞都能发生反应: every collision leads to a reaction
温度升高使一部分原来能量较低的分子变成活化分子，活化分子百分数增大，有效碰撞次数: Raising the temperature turns some lower-energy molecules into activated molecules, increasing their percentage and the number of effective collisions; it is not more molecules, nor a higher concentration.
